about: Smaller fallback pieces. A room is first furnished with the regular pieces of placement_order.md. Only when that leaves a step without any valid placement, the rules below are tried in this order, each on its own; the first rule that furnishes the room completely is used, and the room's score is reduced by penaltyPoints (points of the 0 to 100 room score). When no rule completes the room, the regular result stands. The pieces are made by furn_library/make_fallback_pieces.py.

rules.label: bathtub 1.60 m and washbasin free area 1.12 m deep (instead of 1.70 m and 1.15 m)
children's bed with a free strip of 0.80 m at its end (instead of 0.85 m)
L kitchen with a long leg of 2.30 m (instead of 2.40 m)
kitchen of a 3-room apartment: L of 2.40 + 1.80 m or a 3.60 m line (instead of 2.45 + 3.05 m or 4.80 m)
kitchen of a 3-room apartment with a long leg of 2.30 m: L of 2.30 + 1.80 m or a 3.60 m line
double bed 1.60 m wide with 0.60 m beside it (instead of 2.00 m with 0.80 m)
